shared_elements: low-relief carving on a pale stone surface
animal head with visible eye/muzzle in profile
standing/upright figure rendered in higher relief with arms bent toward the body
horizontal register or band of repeated motifs
schematic rendering of limbs and paws
justification: Both surfaces combine a raised, frontal upright figure whose bent arms converge over the belly with flanking or superimposed profile animals rendered in flat, shallow relief, and both organise part of the imagery into horizontal registers. However, A is a single dominant modelled figure on a broad horizontal slab with only faint flanking carvings, whereas B is a tall vertical T-shaped block crowded with stacked registers of many small linear motifs (row of quadrupeds, patterned band, birds, snake-like forms), giving a wholly different overall format and density.
